waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it.

mutations.name: replay-runs-the-command-again
mutations.why: Stock's own rule (v0.134.1 and before): the relaunch's retry runs a cut or failed command again with the same arguments, so a commit that already happened is made twice.

mutations.name: guard-looks-at-this-life-only
mutations.why: The guard refuses a call journaled by this process instead of an earlier one: the relaunch's replay runs through.

mutations.name: stop-aborts-at-once
mutations.why: session_shutdown aborts the loop before the running command returns (v0.134.1 and before): a short command is cut and its output lost.

mutations.name: record-only-after-the-command
mutations.why: The shell's run records the call only once the command returned: a crash after its effect leaves no record, and the replay runs it again.
mutations.search: /\ ran' = TRUE \* recorded before the command runs
